meta.name: groom
meta.description: Deep-research a feature, bug, or refactor and produce a specified, estimated plan with Definition of Done. Cross-validates architecture with a second model when useful. Use when the user describes a new piece of work that needs to be shaped before implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求拆成可执行的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要把模糊想法变成可执行的开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague requirements into actionable development plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn vague ideas into actionable development tasks

howto.what: Claude 会深入研究一个功能、缺陷或重构任务，然后生成一份包含完成定义的、有估算的计划。必要时会调用第二个模型交叉验证架构。
howto.when: 当你描述一项需要先规划再实施的新工作时，例如提出一个新功能、报告一个 bug 或要求重构。

say.text: 帮我规划一下用户登录功能，给出完成定义和工时估算。
say.note: Claude 会研究并输出计划。

say.text: 分析这个 bug 并制定修复计划，包括完成标准。
say.note: Claude 会分析并生成修复方案。

say.text: 重构订单模块，给出分步计划和估算。
say.note: Claude 会研究并输出重构计划。

howto.what_en: Claude deep-researches a feature, bug, or refactor and produces a specified, estimated plan with Definition of Done. It cross-validates architecture with a second model when useful.
howto.when_en: When you describe a new piece of work that needs shaping before implementation, such as a new feature, bug report, or refactoring request.

say_en.text: Plan the user login feature with DoD and effort estimate.
say_en.note: Claude will research and output a plan.

say_en.text: Analyze this bug and create a fix plan with completion criteria.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and generate a fix plan.

say_en.text: Refactor the order module with step-by-step plan and estimate.
say_en.note: Claude will research and output a refactoring plan.
